$description: Semantic inventory checked by tooling/check-foundations.ts in every brand × appearance × density context: every role must exist with its type on its axis (the file layer that defines it), and every contrast pair must reach its WCAG minimum (4.5 text, 3 borders, icons and focus). Translucent surfaces are composited on color.surface.default before measuring. Pairs are explicit: a role is tested on the backdrops it is designed for. color.surface.muted is a de-emphasized backdrop and is tested with primary and secondary content only; color.status.*.border is decorative (the tinted surface identifies the status) and is not tested. `invariants` lists dimension roles that must equal the sum of other dimension roles in every context (a derived role maintained by hand in each brand or density). color.input.* (formerly color.field.*) paints text entry boxes. color.action.{info,success,warning}.* (added 2026-11-03) mirror the accent family on their palette ramp, for the buttons of an Alert of that intent; action content is also measured on the tinted status surface of the same intent (the solid surface of the new families too; for danger and neutral, whose solid surface is not measured there, the label identifies the button: danger solid reaches 2.86:1 on the danger status surface in dark). `concepts` lists the component ids a semantic role may contain because the role names a general concept, not that component (decisions.md, Semantic role or component token). color.item.* pairs are measured on the surfaces that hold lists (default, overlay) and on the item's own surfaces; color.elevation.border is decorative (the shadow and the surface identify the element) and is not tested.

invariants.note: A focus ring drawn at focus.offset outside a control stays concentric with it.
A text-only control keeps the same inline padding as a field.

concepts.name: icon
concepts.note: An icon next to text in any component: size.icon.* sizes it and color.status.*.icon colors it; the Icon component is one consumer among many.

concepts.name: link
concepts.note: color.content.link is the color of a hyperlink in running text, also used outside the Link component.

concepts.name: toast
concepts.note: layer.toast is a level of the layer scale, which is read as a whole (stacking order).

concepts.name: tooltip
concepts.note: layer.tooltip is a level of the layer scale, which is read as a whole (stacking order).
